svg.title: Index Translator browser components, voices
svg.desc: The voice settings list the voices and remember the chosen one in local storage. A sample is recorded by the microphone recorder or picked as a file, then audio-upload mixes it down and resamples it and encodes it as Ogg Opus when the server takes that, otherwise as WAV, and the voice module sends it to the server. a voice upload: public/speech-ui.ts → public/voice-sample.ts → public/audio-upload.ts → public/mic-recorder.ts.
